items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) officially active after expected-to-play reports; was Q after limited practices.
items.why: Calf issue; Rapoport/ETR expected play, confirmed active
items.implication: High-risk WR3/flex but viable with possible limited strength
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in CHI offense alongside Loveland/Burden/Swift

items.text: Kamara inactive directly lifts Travis Etienne projection as lead back; ETR flags status impact on Etienne and notes NO-DET as up-tempo pace game.
items.why: Kamara out removes committee threat; Thorman snaps/pace shows NO-DET elevated
items.implication: Etienne top-10 RB upside with passing-down and RZ work

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown high ankle sprain will not need surgery but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed no surgery needed
items.implication: Extended absence; NE WR depth and Maye targets shift

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers OUT after meniscus trim Tuesday; realistic chance miss only one game and return Week 2 at LAC.
items.why: Meniscus procedure; team optimistic short absence
items.implication: Michael Mayer primary TE fill-in short-term; monitor W2 return
items.opportunity: Targets/routes to Mayer in LV offense

items.text: Cooper Rush starts at QB for Falcons; Tua and Penix inactive; Zaccheaus emergency QB and 3rd RB with only Bijan and Brian Robinson active at RB.
items.implication: Lower efficiency for ATL pass game; Bijan still featured, thin RB depth

items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) situation murky for SNF vs DAL; up to him after full practices, Giants elevated Berrios and Cambre. Main slate otherwise locked.
items.why: Returning from prior ACL; full practice but decision his, elevations contingency
items.implication: If out, boost to Fields/Mooney/Likely; if in, still not 100%
items.opportunity: If inactive: target share to other Giants pass-catchers

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to play vs Chargers; Q after limited practices but trending for debut.
items.why: High ankle sprain preseason; limited all week, coach optimistic, sources confirm
items.implication: Likely split with Allgeier; mid-low RB2 debut value, monitor workload
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps in committee; potential role expansion if healthy

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Isaiah Likely ranks high in FPP target; Nabers won't be 100%, Giants WR2 thin (Fields/Mooney) — gimme all the Likely.
items.why: Historical TE efficiency + Nabers limitation creates target vacuum
items.implication: Strong TE streamer/start if Nabers limited/out

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs remains on Commissioner Exempt; NFL could count time as served toward potential DV suspension (CBA 6-game min possible).
items.implication: Availability murky; monitor suspension length for GB RB depth

items.text: Berry keeping Chuba Hubbard open as viable flex this week despite committee noise.
items.why: Viable flex option in CAR backfield

items.text: ETR/Thorman Week 1 snaps & pace: NO@DET up-tempo; MIA@LV slow slog.
items.why: Pace projections favor higher-volume NO-DET, suppress MIA-LV
items.implication: Boost Etienne/Olave/Lions skill; fade slower game scripts

items.text: Matthew Berry: Don't panic on CMC usage/Kaelon Black looks; banged-up preseason, long flight, weird game — CMC is a BUY LOW.
items.why: Contrarian take on early usage concerns post-preseason/opener context

items.text: Berry: Olave averaged 29% target share and 14.7+ PPR in 75% of games with Shough; Lions safeties on IR, high O/U.
items.why: Prior Shough chemistry + matchup (Branch/Joseph IR) + pace

items.text: Berry: Saquon vs WAS averages 136.5 rush yds/6.0 YPC and 21+ PPR in 4 meetings; WAS front still projects below average.
items.why: Historical dominance vs WAS + defensive projection

items.text: Berry: Herbert FPP/A 52% higher with Alt on field; Alt healthy; Cards DL/secondary ranked poorly by PFF.
items.why: OL health boost + weak ARI pass rush/secondary

items.text: Berry: Parker Washington 24% target share when 70%+ routes; 16.4 PPG at 15%+ share; Ward likely on BTJ opens slot/opportunity.
Berry: When MHJ on field Wilson 5.5 PPG/13% share; off field 28% share. MHJ expected to play.
items.implication: Wilson more viable if MHJ limited; otherwise suppress
items.opportunity: Target share swing on MHJ snaps
